name: a held entry stays held before its releaseAt
a held entry is released at its releaseAt
releaseDue releases only the entries whose time has come
release of one entry answers true; of an entry not held, false
leaving the app releases every held entry
numbering stops before an entry that would take the request body, its jcs, over PUSH_MAX_BYTES; the next push sends it
push numbers ready entries and passes over held ones
a released delete is sent as its own intent, numbered after the ready update committed before it
an update of a held create is held back unnumbered, a later independent edit is numbered past both, and the release numbers the two in commit order
an edit of a record a held-back entry touches is held back too, and a held-back command stops numbering
